newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares reverse day-old losses at close.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares reverse day-old losses at close.

text.p: Share prices reversed losses made a day earlier and closed higher on Tuesday thanks to advances by index heavyweights Ericsson, Astra and banks following a smattering of first quarter results.
The forestry sector index ended flat, however.
More gains were seen likely, brokers said.
The bourse's general index ended 1.74 percent higher at 2,622.71 on turnover of 5.4 billion crowns.
Telecommunications company Ericsson ended 8.5 crowns higher at 246 but off highs after Finnish rival Nokia posted strong first quarter earnings.
Drug company Astra soared 15 crowns to 315 in a strong rebound after having been sluggish since reporting a lower than expected first quarter profit last week.
Rival Pharmacia & Upjohn ended flat at 219 crowns after releasing first quarter earnings but the company had already issued a profit warning.

The banking sector ended 2.14 percent higher after Nordbanken, S-E-Banken and Foreningsbanken posted first quarter figures. Industrivarden and Investor also reported quarterly data and the investment sector index rose 0.99 percent.
Household appliance group Electrolux and forestry group MoDo both published first quarter earnings but while Electrolux plummeted 15 crowns to 458, MoDo rose 10 to 230.
